Fake Ledger Phishing Site Tops Google Search Results with Over 1M Monthly Visits

According to Bitcoin News, amid ongoing investigations into an estimated $86 million in wallet thefts linked to Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis, security researcher Cyber Scrilla discovered a fraudulent Ledger phishing website and application appearing at the top of Google Search, designed to trick users into submitting their 24-word recovery phrases. Google reportedly displays more than 1 million visits over the past 30 days. The alert follows a September investigation by cybersecurity firm Zscaler, which uncovered malicious Google ads impersonating Ledger and redirecting users to fake wallet-verification pages.

100 Arcus points = $1000–$1500? 😱

Built a little calculator for your future Arcus airdrop fantasies 💦

How rich you get depends on how optimistic you are with the inputs 
https://arcus-point-calc.vercel.app

But what assumptions would actually support $10–$15 per point?

First, we need to estimate how many points will be in circulation by the end of the program

Arcus distributes 250K points weekly. The program ends no later than June 30, 2027

Assuming 39 Season 1 distributions + a hypothetical 1.25M Season 0 points, that’s 11M total. Season 0’s actual amount is still unknown

The other big unknown: how much token supply goes to these points

At 11M points:
• $1B FDV + 5% allocation = $4.55/point
• $1B FDV + 10% allocation = $9.09/point

For $10–$15 per point, the rewards pool needs to be worth $110M–$165M

That requires:
- 5% allocation → $2.2B–$3.3B FDV
- 10% allocation → $1.1B–$1.65B FDV

papertrade launch timing and details

papertrade is expected to launch at 14:00 UTC on 10.10.2026, following the scheduled hyperevm network upgrade. 

at this time trading through the frontend will be enabled.

deposits will pause for a short period of time at 13:45 UTC, fifteen minutes before, to ensure that trading has the utmost priority during launch. if you wish to participate in the launch you must predeposit.

launch congestion

papertrade will be congested at the start due to launch demand. expect temporarily long confirmation wait times, especially for smaller notional trades. 

the frontend relayer plays an important role during launch, controlling how transactions are submitted to the hyperevm. some actions like staking distributions run separately in big blocks. the chain will always look as if only half of all possible gas is being used, this is optimal. using more than this would exponentially raise fees within minutes to unpayable prices.
